resource_name: Data-Driven Animal Pose Assembly with Calibration
description: Expanded open-source toolbox for multi-animal pose estimation with multi-task architecture, data-driven assembly, network flow tracking, unsupervised ID tracking, and GUIs for annotation and verification.

A multi-scale deep learning model for multi-animal pose estimation with data-driven skeleton assembly, keypoint detection, part affinity fields (PAFs), and animal reidentification (reID). The model is adapted from ImageNet-pretrained ResNets and EfficientNets and uses customized deconvolution layers to predict keypoint locations and connections. It achieves high accuracy in localizing keypoints and assembling individuals from multiple animals in a scene.
A comprehensive tracking system for multi-animal behavior analysis, including local tracking with ellipse tracker and global stitching using spatio-temporal cues.

A multi-animal pose estimation and tracking system extending DeepLabCut with improved CNNs (DLCRNet), automatic skeleton selection, fast trackers, and identity-based tracking for marked and unmarked animals.
A tool for pose estimation, skeleton selection, and tracking in animals with minimal programming required. All steps can be run in ten lines of code or via a GUI.

Deep-learning tool for animal pose estimation using keypoint detection and multi-scale architectures, with support for ResNet and EfficientNet backbones, PAFs for limb linking, and multi-stage refinement. Includes training strategies like data augmentation and keypoint-aware cropping.
A deep learning-based tool for pose estimation and multi-animal tracking, enabling identity prediction, data-driven graph selection, and animal assembly using CNNs and part affinity fields (PAFs).
A method for multi-animal pose estimation using graph-based keypoint connectivity, prior calibration, and temporal coherence weighting.
Tracking-by-detection framework using SORT for local tracklet generation and tracklet stitching, with Box and Ellipse trackers for animal movement estimation.
A tool for reconstructing full animal trajectories from sparse tracklets using network flow minimization and affinity models (motion, spatial proximity, shape similarity, dynamic similarity).

A tool for animal pose estimation and tracking, including automatic tracklet stitching and unsupervised ID tracking using transformers. Implements tracklet stitching after assembly and tracking, with manual refinement via GUI. Uses keypoint embeddings and transformers for identity recognition, and supports evaluation via MOTA metrics.
specific_target: Mice, Marmosets, Fish, Parenting mice with pups
Animals in video tracking (e.g., marmosets, quadrupeds)
